personas.name: Parent
personas.short_description: Describes the family's situation for a child in Class 11–12, reviews matching schemes, and shares the checklist with family.
key_responsibilities: Describe a situation in one short sentence, by typing or speaking, in English or the regional language
Answer only 2–4 simple follow-up questions, or skip optional ones
See schemes grouped as Likely eligible, May qualify, or Not currently eligible
Change a profile answer and see which scheme results change and which rule caused it
Share a checklist summary with family without sensitive details
Have results and instructions read aloud

personas.name: Low-income Student in Class 11–12
personas.short_description: Enters their own situation, checks which schemes they may qualify for, and tracks application progress on a personal checklist.
key_responsibilities: Describe a situation in one short sentence, by typing or speaking, in English or the regional language
See schemes grouped as Likely eligible, May qualify, or Not currently eligible
Open a scheme to see why it matched and what still needs verification
Save a personalised checklist and track progress from Not started to Awaiting outcome
Read how HaqPath decides and what data it does not collect
